content: Dr. Salih Al-Ansari is an advocate for health promotion and education aimed at combating non-communicable diseases (NCDs) through physical activity and walking. He is the owner and CEO of the Health Promotion Center in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. No conflicts of interest were identified in his case. Dr. Stuart Biddle specializes in physical activity among youth. He has received research funds and paid consultancy but no conflicts of interest were identified. Dr. Katja Borodulin focuses on physical activity during pregnancy. She is employed at the National Institute for Health and Welfare and the Age Institute in Finland and has received research funds. No conflicts of interest were identified. Dr. Matthew Buman’s expertise lies in sleep and physical activity in individuals living with chronic conditions. He declared no conflicts of interest. Dr. Greet Cardon specializes in physical activity among youth. She declared no conflicts of interest. Ms. Catherine Carty focuses on physical activity in individuals living with disabilities. She has received research funds but no conflicts of interest were identified. Dr. Jean-Philippe Chaput’s area of expertise is sleep. He declared no conflicts of interest. Dr. Sebastien Chastin specializes in physical activity and health, with a focus on objective measurement of physical activity. He has received research funds but no conflicts of interest were identified. Dr. Paddy Dempsey’s expertise includes physical activity and sedentary behavior in adults and individuals living with chronic conditions. He is employed and has received research funds, but no conflicts of interest were identified. Dr. Loretta DiPietro focuses on physical activity in older adults. She declared no conflicts of interest. Dr. Ulf Ekelund specializes in sedentary behavior and physical activity in youth. He declared no conflicts of interest. Dr. Joseph Firth’s expertise lies in the relationship between physical activity and mental health. He declared no conflicts of interest. Dr. Christine Friedenreich focuses on physical activity in individuals living with chronic conditions, as well as the relationship between physical activity and cancer risk. She declared no conflicts of interest. Dr. Leandro Garcia specializes in physical activity and mental health. He is employed and has received paid consultancy, but no conflicts of interest were identified. Dr. Muthoni Gichu’s expertise is in policy implementation at the national government level. She declared no conflicts of interest. Dr. Russ Jago focuses on physical activity in youth. He declared no conflicts of interest. Dr. Peter Katzmarzyk specializes in physical activity and sedentary behavior in youth. He received travel support to assist guideline committees but no conflicts of interest were identified. Dr. Estelle V. Lambert’s expertise includes physical activity and obesity. Further details about her involvement were not provided in the excerpt.
